      - name: Check formatting
        run: |
          # 获取准确的变更文件列表
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRTUXB "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}".."${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}")
          echo "Changed files: ${CHANGED_FILES}"

          ERROR_FOUND=0
          IFS=$'\n'  # 处理含空格的文件名
          for FILE in $CHANGED_FILES; do
            if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(c|cc|cpp|cxx|h|hh|hpp|hxx)$ ]]; then
              echo "Checking: $FILE"
              
              # 生成格式化临时文件
              TEMP_FILE="${FILE}.formatted"
              clang-format -style=file -fallback-style=LLVM "$FILE" > "$TEMP_FILE"
              
              # 对比差异
              if ! diff -u --color=always "$FILE" "$TEMP_FILE"; then
                echo "::error file=$FILE::Code style issues detected"
                ERROR_FOUND=1
              fi
              rm "$TEMP_FILE"
            fi
          done

          if [ "$ERROR_FOUND" -eq 1 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi
